insights.title: The packet contains proposals, not a current bill
insights.text: The July 2025 packet labels the tuition schedule projected and the 2026–27 housing/food rates proposed. Use this demo to inspect the proposal, not to claim these are today’s approved charges. The curated datasets cover pages 54, 63, 66, 67 and 69, not all 70 pages.

insights.title: Resident and nonresident tuition changes differ
insights.text: University Park lower-division annual tuition is $20,468 → $20,878 for Pennsylvania residents (+$410, approximately 2.00%) and $42,860 → $44,574 for nonresidents (+$1,714, approximately 4.00%). Percentages here are computed from the printed annual tuition. Annual, semester, and per-credit rates are distinct billing bases.

insights.title: Standard double-room proposal
insights.text: Double Traditional housing lists $4,039 approved for 2025–26 and $4,150 proposed for 2026–27, per person per semester. The printed increase is $111 and the printed percentage 2.75%. This covers housing alone, not food or tuition.

insights.title: Compare room types without changing occupancy basis
insights.text: The housing table separates room types and occupant counts. The University Park dataset includes both residence halls and undergraduate apartments. Rates are per person per semester; do not multiply by occupants unless explicitly constructing a total-room comparison.

insights.title: Campus groups do not share one increase
insights.text: Commonwealth Campus group 1 rows generally show 1.75% proposed increases; group 2 rows list 0.00%, preserving their unchanged approved/proposed rates. The two RA rows are separately listed at 2.75%.

insights.title: Student fees depend on credit load
insights.text: University Park student-initiated fees are listed as $320 per semester for 9+ credits, $240 for 5–<9 credits, and $160 for <5 credits. This fee is separate from tuition, housing and food. Annual medical-program fees are not mixed into this semester comparison.

insights.title: A housing-and-food comparison with explicit scope
insights.text: For UP, the source’s standard double-room/mid-level meal package is $6,940 per semester in 2025–26 versus $7,138 proposed for 2026–27 (+$198, printed 2.85%). Two identical semesters would imply $14,276 for the proposed package; that is a calculated scenario, not a quoted annual attendance cost and excludes tuition and other expenses.

limitations: The document is a July 2025 proposal packet; proposed 2026–27 rates are not asserted to be approved or currently payable.
Different annual/semester/per-credit/per-person rates are not combined into an invented total cost.
